name: MyTurn
description: MyTurn is California's official vaccine scheduling and digital record system, making it easy to find vaccine appointments, access your immunization records, and stay up to date on recommended vaccines.
fullDescription: MyTurn is California's official vaccine scheduling and digital record system, making it easy to find vaccine appointments, access your immunization records, and stay up to date on recommended vaccines.
whatTheyOffer:
- COVID-19 vaccine appointments
- Flu vaccine appointments (during flu season, early fall through late spring)
- Mpox vaccine scheduling
- Routine and back-to-school vaccine appointments
- Vaccine Locator, including walk-in clinics and no-cost options for the uninsured
- Link to your Digital Vaccine Record
- Phone help in 250+ languages
howToGetIt: Visit myturn.ca.gov to make an appointment or use the Vaccine Locator to find clinics near you. For help, call the hotline at 833-422-4255 (Monday-Friday, 8am-5pm). Get your digital vaccine record at myvaccinerecord.cdph.ca.gov.
keywords: MyTurn, vaccine appointment, COVID vaccine, flu shot, mpox, immunization record, digital vaccine record, vaccine locator, booster
